verdict.rationale: Perplexity has a dedicated rate-limits and usage-tiers docs page. It describes tiered rate limits that rise automatically as you spend more on API credits, with no downgrade once a tier is reached. Combined with pay-as-you-go billing and no subscription, that is a clear self-serve upgrade path. missing for 10: actual per-tier requests-per-minute figures in the evidence, any documentation of concurrency caps specifically, independent or hands-on corroboration of the limits.
